capabilities: Apply templates automatically when notes are created or renamed
Match note titles by prefix, suffix, or contains rules
Prepend template content to existing notes on rename
Configure case sensitivity and custom template folders
motivation: The author primarily wanted quicker templating of notes in a Zettelkasten system, where reference, literature, and permanent notes each get their own template.
problem: Obsidian's templates require manual insertion, so notes that follow a naming convention must be templated by hand each time.
summary: Rule-based templating that automatically applies a matching template file to new or renamed notes based on their title.
